about.text: Arkhi distilled again to make it stronger. In Mongolian the grades have their own names: arz is arkhi distilled a second time and khorz is arz distilled once more, and a proverb warns that distilling khorz again gives khor, poison.

how.text: The arkhi is run through the still again. In the Mongolian heritage description, distilling fermented milk makes arz and distilling zar again makes khorz, a strong spirit. No temperatures or strengths were found in an opened source, so no table.
